title: THE KINGS WEST OF THE JORDAN

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Here is a list of the kings of the land that Joshua and the Israelites conquered on the west side of the Jordan, from Baal Gad in the Valley of Lebanon to Mount Halak, which rises toward Seir (their lands Joshua gave as an inheritance to the tribes of Israel according to their tribal divisions— the hill country, the western foothills, the Arabah, the mountain slopes, the wilderness and the Negev—the lands of the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites) - Josh 12:7-8 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Now the record turns from the eastern conquests under Moses to the western conquests under Joshua. And straightaway we read that the land was given "as an inheritance to the tribes of Israel according to their tribal divisions." The whole point of the fighting was not conquest for its own sake — it was inheritance. God was settling His people in the land He had promised them long ago.

Look at that sweep of terrain: hill country, foothills, wilderness, Negev. And look at that list of peoples: Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, and more. What had once been a land full of enemies was now a land full of homes for God's people. The very ground that had belonged to hostile nations became the settled inheritance of the tribes.

This is how God works — He does not merely rescue His people from danger; He brings them into a place of belonging. Salvation is never only about what we are saved from, but what we are saved for. In Christ we are not just forgiven; we are given an inheritance, a place in God's family that can never be taken away (1 Pet 1:3-4). The battles of this life are real, but they are moving toward a settled home that God Himself has prepared.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you think of salvation mostly as escape, or also as inheritance?
- What does it mean to you that God has prepared a place of belonging for you?
- How does a secure inheritance in Christ change how you face today's battles?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that You do not only rescue me from danger but bring me into belonging. Thank You for the inheritance kept safe for me in Christ. Amen.
